tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
All terms & conditions are uploaded in tender document

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: RC book of the vehicle in the name of the tenderer, Fitness Certificate, Pollution Under Control (PUC) certificate, Proof of payment of vehicle tax (up to date),Proof of payment of vehicle insurance (up to date),Valid permit document issued by the Transport Department, License document showing the vehicle registration number, issued by the Food Safety and Standards Authority Copy of PAN card in the name of the tenderer, Bank account details document, Latest B-Extract document, The tenderer must completely fill Annexure-B, clearly mentioning the vehicle number to be deployed for the route. Only one vehicle document should be submitted per route. As per the Food Safety and Standards Act 2006 a valid license must be obtained.
